notes.title: FINALLY a update!
notes.notes:
OK, so I finally go the game  updated. So exciting. This update is yuge, You gonna love it! Please let me know if you find anything wrong by leaving a report in the community forum. hope you enjoy the update and thanks for playing!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/2YiR4YL8DhU8H6IOXw/giphy.gif[/img]


[b]This update includes...[/b]

1. 32 new levels
2. Brand new world
3. New board piece, the Color bomb. When jumped on will turn the qube and any qube around it to the color of the bomb. 
4. New music track for world 4
5. Fixed Upload and Download in workshop
6. Fixed achievements.
